The '''Manaan Special Warfare Group (MSWG)''' was a defense force group on the planet [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].<ref name="Legacy" />

==Overview==
The MSWG was a specialized force group created to defend Manaan territory from hostile incursions. Using unconventional tactics, advanced equipment to boost their natural abilities, and innovative [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] technology, the MSWG [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] proved essential in protecting Manaan's citizens and resources. Their motto translates into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] as: "For sea and spirit."<ref name="MSWG" />

==History==
The MSWG was founded by [[Wen Gallo]], [[Lak Talsa]], and [[Ji Shuul]] after the [[Battle of Gwaria Trench]] where Gallo's company suffered significant losses to kolto raiders.<ref name="CX" /><ref name="MSWG" />

During the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Invasion of Manaan|invasion]] around [[3625 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.0}}</ref> the MSWG joined forces with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to prevent the theft of [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] by the resurgent Sith Empire.<ref name="Legacy" />
